laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Van sy 27 jaar as politieke gevangene
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Van Mandela se 27 jaar as politieke gevangene
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The block opens under a new heading with a bare 'sy', so the referent is named once for a reader who starts here.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'sy' can only refer to Mandela, who is the subject of the block just before it, and the next block opens with a bare 'hy' too, so naming him here alone is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: A bare '18' after 'mense van' reads incomplete; 'jaar' makes clear it is an age.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'mense van 18 en ouer' is ordinary, clear Afrikaans for an age in a voting sentence, so adding 'jaar' only reads differently.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: swaar werk doen soos klip breek
laat_vaar_vorige.na: swaar werk doen, soos klip breek
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: A comma before the examples stops 'swaar werk doen soos klip breek' being read as 'work as hard as breaking stone' and marks the examples clearly.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The AWS 2017 does not require a comma before 'soos' introducing examples, the sentence reads clearly in context, and the lesson already writes 'dinge soos kragmaste' without one, so this is a lateral move that would make the lesson inconsistent.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: te beplan om die regering onder druk te plaas
laat_vaar_vorige.na: te beplan wat die regering onder druk moes plaas
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Two stacked 'om ... te' clauses in one sentence read heavily; a relative clause on 'sabotasie' keeps the purpose and flows better.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The original purpose clause correctly ties the aim to Mandela's act of planning; the proposal makes the sabotage itself the agent, adds the modal 'moes' (had to / was meant to), and leaves the relative clause separated from 'sabotasie' by 'te beplan', so it is no clearer and shifts the meaning.
